scripts.build: bun run --filter @ae-hq/tokens build && bun run --filter platform-app build && bun run --filter platform-api build
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,app -c blue,green "bun run --filter platform-api dev" "bun run --filter platform-app dev"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/tokens --noEmit && tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p packages/ui --noEmit && tsc -p packages/eslint-plugin-ae-hq --noEmit && tsc -p apps/platform-api --noEmit && tsc -p apps/platform-app --noEmit
scripts.lint: biome check packages/tokens packages/ui packages/eslint-plugin-ae-hq docs eslint.config.mjs && bun x eslint apps/platform-app/src/routes/**/*.tsx
scripts.test: bun test --filter platform-api && bun run --filter @ae-hq/shared test && bun run --filter @ae-hq/tokens test && bun run --filter @ae-hq/ui test
